result.summary: Overall layout looks mostly fine; one minor styling inconsistency found with the heart/favorite icon contrast on the second promotional card.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the pizza promo card has low contrast against the dark background circle, making it slightly harder to see compared to the same icon on the ramen card which uses a white background circle.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent background style (e.g., semi-transparent white circle) for the favorite icon across all promotional cards.
